updates.body: Some Logs queries in GCP US Central (prod-us-central-0) were slower than usual between 12:08 and 12:34 UTC. The issue is believed to be mitigated, and the team is monitoring while the cause is investigated.

This incident has been resolved. Some Logs queries in GCP US Central (prod-us-central-0) were slower than usual between 12:08 and 12:34 UTC. Some Metrics alert and recording rule evaluations in the same region were also delayed between 12:11 and 12:44 UTC. Both issues have been mitigated.
